title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Operational Guidelines
issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
document_text:
PRADHAN MANTRI FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY)
REVISED OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES

1. OBJECTIVE: To provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of failure of any of the notified crops as a result of natural calamities, pests and diseases.

2. FARMER PREMIUM RATES: Maximum premium payable by farmers is 2.0% of Sum Insured for Kharif food and oilseeds crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseeds crops, and 5.0% for Annual Commercial and Horticultural crops. The balance premium is subsidized equally by Central and State Governments.

3. COVERAGE OF LOCALIZED CALAMITIES: Loss or damage resulting from occurrence of identified localized risks of hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloudburst and natural fire affecting isolated farms in the notified area.

4. TIME LIMIT FOR CLAIM INTIMATION: In case of localized calamities or post-harvest losses, the insured farmer must intimate the loss within 72 hours of the occurrence of the calamity through the Crop Insurance App, toll-free number 14447, or to the designated Agriculture Officer or financial institution.

5. ASSESSMENT AND SETTLEMENT: Joint survey by the Insurance Company and State Agriculture Department will be completed within 10 days of loss intimation, and claim settlement will be credited directly to the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account within 15 days of survey completion.
